answer: Correlation penalties: when many new agents graze the same meadow of tasks with near-identical answers, timing and wording, the network groups them as a cluster and splits one reward among the whole group. Clones gain nothing over a single honest agent, and if the cluster keeps growing the penalty can spiral into slashing the stakes they posted. A velvet-glove start, with an iron price: the attacker pays a stake for every fake identity but collects only one share.
